ui.purpose: Display safety evaluation and detected red flags.
ui.prompt: Safety Assessment: Critical Red Flags Identified

content.label: Upfront Equipment Fee
content.detail: Asking for payment before an interview or employment is a severe indicator of fraud. Legitimate employers provide necessary equipment or standard onboarding without upfront charges.

content.label: Banking Password Request
content.detail: No legitimate employer or recruiter will ever request online banking passwords, OTPs, or direct login credentials.

content.label: Unverified Contact Channel
content.detail: Offers sent exclusively via unverified text messaging without official company domain verification carry high risk.

ui.purpose: Guide user on immediate safe practices.

content.label: Immediate Safety Rule
content.detail: Do not transfer money, do not share passwords, and do not follow links provided in the message.

derived_signals.signal: High fraud risk detected based on sensitive credential and upfront payment requests.
derived_signals.basis: User reported a text request for equipment payment prior to an interview and a request for banking passwords.

unknowns: Verified careers domain or requisition ID

result.summary: This communication shows critical fraud indicators, specifically upfront payment for equipment and a request for banking passwords. Stop engagement immediately to protect financial and personal security.

evidence.label: Legal Entity Verification
evidence.detail: No verified legal entity name or company record provided.

official_role_evidence.label: Role Existence
official_role_evidence.detail: No official job posting or requisition match found.

contact_channel_checks.label: Text Message Delivery
contact_channel_checks.detail: Contact originated through unverified SMS/text without official domain backing.

process_checks.label: Pre-interview Payment Demand
process_checks.detail: Requirement of equipment payment before interview contradicts standard recruitment practices.

red_flags.evidence: User was asked for banking password via text.
red_flags.why_it_matters: Legitimate employers never ask for account passwords or banking login credentials.

red_flags.evidence: User was asked to pay for equipment before an interview.
red_flags.why_it_matters: Demanding upfront money for onboarding or equipment is a hallmark of employment scams.

sensitive_data_or_payment_requests.label: Credentials and Payment
sensitive_data_or_payment_requests.detail: Requests for banking passwords and pre-interview equipment fees.

safe_next_actions.label: Cease Communication
safe_next_actions.detail: Do not send funds, provide passwords, or click links from the sender.

unknowns.label: Company Identity
unknowns.detail: No official employer domain or registry record exists in context.

next_actions.label: Review Common Employment Scams
next_actions.detail: Learn standard security checks to verify employers through official channels.

blockers: Critical security red flags present: payment demanded and banking password requested.

handoff.summary: The offer presents critical fraud flags: requesting banking passwords and upfront equipment payment via text. Advised immediate stop.

result.summary: Assessment complete with status HIGH_RISK_STOP due to credential and payment requests.

evidence_and_unknowns: User confirmed text offer requested pre-interview payment and banking password.
handoff.recommended_next_action: Do not engage or transfer credentials; cease contact.

context.user_message: I received a hypothetical job offer by text. They want a payment for equipment before interview and ask for my banking password. I have no verified company details. Help me understand what to check. Do not label the company verified or invent a lookup.
